TaxRate.name: TaxRate
TaxRate.description: Represents a tax rate for a tax code and country.

GeoCountryId.description: The ID of the GeoCountry for which the tax rate applies. You can define only one tax rate per GeoCountry and tax code combination.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, it's possible the user accessed data in this record or list view but didn't viewed it directly.

Name.description: The unique ID of the tax rate.

OwnerId.description: The TaxRate record owner. By default, the record owner is the user who created the record.

Rate.description: The tax percentage rate that will be applied to orders.

TaxCode.description: The code used to calculate the tax rate for the invoice line.

ApplicationBasis.description: Specifies whether the tax rate is applied on the net or gross amount.

City.description: The city to which the tax rate applies.

Country.description: The country name that’s derived from the GeoCountry field value.

CurrencyIsoCode.description: The currency ISO code that’s applicable to the tax rate.

EndDate.description: The date until when the tax rate is valid.

FlatTaxAmount.description: The flat tax amount that’s applied to the transaction.

GeoStateId.description: The ID of the GeoState for which the tax rate applies.

LegalEntityId.description: The legal entity to which the tax rate applies.

ProductCode.description: The code of the product for which the tax rate applies.

RateUsageType.description: Specifies whether the tax rate is created for Commerce or Revenue Cloud.

StartDate.description: The date from when the tax rate is valid.

State.description: The state name that’s derived from the GeoState field value.

ZipCode.description: The postal or ZIP code to which the tax rate applies.

TaxRate.accessRules: The TaxRate object is available if B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce is enabled.
